guide_solution: (a) We went to his residence as soon as we knew about his accident. (b) As you sow, so shall you reap. (c) If he had studied more sincerely, he could have had a chance at a medical college. (d) Study regularly lest you should fail in the examination. (e) What is lotted cannot be blotted.
